svg.title: Layer-by-layer matrix math for 4→3→2→1 neural network
svg.desc: Three transitions showing matrix multiply plus bias then sigmoid activation, with bracket lines drawn as SVG paths.
svg.text: Forward pass — complete matrix operations layer by layer
Step 2 : a¹ = σ(z¹) — sigmoid applied element-wise to each z¹ᵢ
σ(z) = 1 / (1 + e⁻ᶻ) each output is a real number in (0, 1)
Step 2 : a² = σ(z²) — sigmoid applied element-wise
Step 2 : ŷ = σ(z³) — final scalar output, a single number in (0, 1)
ŷ = σ( W³ · σ( W² · σ( W¹ · x + b¹ ) + b² ) + b³ )
inner σ fires first, its output (3×1) feeds W², then that output (2×1) feeds W³, giving scalar ŷ
rows = neurons in next layer, cols = neurons in current layer → W¹(3×4) W²(2×3) W³(1×2)
